description: This PHP source file defines the controller class 'AOS_QuotesController' for the SuiteCRM module 'AOS_Quotes'. It extends the 'SugarController' to handle the 'editview' action, fetching and populating quote-related data from various related tables such as invoices, contracts, accounts, contacts, and opportunities.

classes.name: AOS_QuotesController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the edit view of quotes in SuiteCRM, with logic to populate quote data based on related invoice, contract, account, contact, and opportunity details.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Handles the editing view of quotes, retrieving related data from invoices, contracts, accounts, contacts, and opportunities, and setting bean properties accordingly.
